source: Full-precision orbital elements pulled from the game client (DATA_DATA system payloads) on 2026-08-16. This is the SEED for re-cutting raukk_orbits.json, not a replacement for it — see notIngestedYet.

units.assetEquivalent: raukk_orbits.json stores round(semiMajorAxis / 1e6), i.e. thousands of km
units.note: Planet axes come back as whole metres; the station's does not (46807737537.4384), which suggests planets are generated on a grid and stations placed off it.

notIngestedYet: Deliberately NOT merged into raukk_orbits.json. Two systems out of 4,576 would leave the asset silently mixed — some entries precise, some rounded, with nothing marking which — and that is worse than uniformly rounded. The ingest wants a full pull. The shipped asset is untouched and the damage model still reads it.

bodies.name: Hortus Station
bodies.note: Stations carry real orbits. raukkOrbitalPeriodDays has always needed an orbitAuOverride for stations; this removes the need to guess one.

identificationsConfirmed: Promitor a, Dreamerr Prime b, Beanironia c, Helion Prime d, Shiptronia e — every VH-331 name inferred from map radius ratios is confirmed outright. That was the weakest identification set in the map work and it is now closed.

periodShiftsFromExactElements.comment: phase shift over the 4,720-day baseline when the rounded axis is replaced by the exact one
periodShiftsFromExactElements.reading: Real rounding error was far kinder than the half-ulp worst case: VH-331a stores 23844 against a true 23844.056, so 0.056 rather than 0.5. VH-331b drew badly at 0.418 and carries 9.2 deg. The 24 deg worst case quoted earlier was a bound, not an estimate — the realised errors here run 0.1 to 9 deg.

nextLimit: With exact axes and exact masses the next term is the gravitational constant the engine actually uses. A relative error of 1e-5 in GM is about 19 deg of phase for VH-331a over this baseline, so G is now the floor — and it is calibratable from any timed conjunction, since it enters every body of a system the same way.
